acceptance: The introducing commit(s) and the root cause of both failures are identified with run ids.
Fixed in one PR, or reverted, without weakening the tests. `core` is green on a fresh PR.
If the cause is runner-environment drift (e.g. a Python 3.14 image change), it is pinned or handled, and the drift is recorded.
description:
Since about 2026-11-07 14:00Z, the required `core` check has failed on nearly every PR (#4021, #4022, #4023, #4025 and other open branches), failing the same way after 3 reruns:
- test (ubuntu-latest, 3.14): tests/unit/test_heavy_choke_points.py machine-stop and slow-stop tests fail;
- medium-test shard 1: TestTPCHThroughputOnSQLite setup hits 60 s timeouts (also seen on red trunk run on #4016).
Trunk (3.12 fast) is green on a97efb2. Nothing can arm while core is red.
